name: MAX30205 body temperature sensor
description: Maxim (Analog Devices) clinical-grade digital temperature sensor: 16-bit, 0.00390625 °C resolution, ±0.1 °C from 37 to 39 °C, specified for 0 to 50 °C, with an open-drain overtemperature (OS) output and an I2C interface. The chip runs on 2.7–3.3 V; the breakout adds a 3.3 V regulator and BSS138 level shifters. Sold as: ProtoCentral MAX30205 Body Temperature Sensor Breakout Board (6-pin header: SDA, SCL, OS, 3V3, GND, VIN), I2C address 0x48 (A0–A2 jumpers on the back, all to GND by default).
eli5: A very precise thermometer chip meant to touch your skin and read body temperature.

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (level-shifted, 10 kΩ pull-up to VIN on the board)

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (level-shifted, 10 kΩ pull-up to VIN on the board)

pins.name: OS
pins.description: Overtemperature output (open-drain, active low by default, pulled up on the board); not needed for basic use

pins.name: 3V3
pins.description: 3.3 V output of the on-board regulator; leave unconnected

pins.name: VIN
pins.description: Supply 3.0–5.5 V into the 3.3 V regulator. The I2C pull-ups go to VIN, so use 3.3 V with an ESP32 or Pico

supplierQuery: MAX30205 body temperature sensor breakout I2C
buildNotes: Power VIN from 3.3 V on an ESP32 or Pico: the board's SDA/SCL pull-ups (and the OS pull-up) go to VIN, so 5 V on VIN would put 5 V on your GPIO pins.
Default address 0x48 (A0, A1, A2 jumpers to GND). With A0 to VDD it answers at 0x49; each of A0–A2 moved to VDD adds 1, 2 or 4.
Temperature register 0x00: 16-bit two's complement, MSB first, 1 LSB = 0.00390625 °C. A new value every 44–50 ms in continuous mode.
The chip measures its own die temperature: for body temperature press the sensor side firmly against the skin and wait a few minutes for it to settle.
Accuracy is specified only from 0 to 50 °C (±0.1 °C between 37 and 39 °C).

driver.code:
# MAX30205 human body temperature sensor (Maxim/Analog Devices), MicroPython driver.
# Written from the MAX30205 datasheet (Rev 0): four 16-bit registers behind a pointer byte,
# temperature = 16-bit two's complement, MSB first, 1 LSB = 0.00390625 degC (normal format).
import time

REG_TEMP = 0x00   # read-only temperature
REG_CONFIG = 0x01  # 8-bit configuration
REG_THYST = 0x02  # hysteresis set point (POR 75 degC)
REG_TOS = 0x03    # overtemperature set point (POR 80 degC)

_SHUTDOWN = 0x01
_ONE_SHOT = 0x80
_LSB = 0.00390625


def _to_c(raw):
    if raw & 0x8000:
        raw -= 0x10000
    return raw * _LSB


def _from_c(c):
    return int(round(c / _LSB)) & 0xFFFF


class MAX30205:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x48):
        """addr 0x48 = A0, A1, A2 all tied to GND (datasheet Table 1, 90h)."""
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        # Continuous conversion, comparator mode, OS active low, 1 fault,
        # normal data format, bus timeout enabled (the power-on defaults).
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, REG_CONFIG, b'\x00')
        time.sleep_ms(50)  # one conversion takes up to 50 ms

    def temperature(self):
        """Latest temperature in degC (continuous mode, a new value every ~50 ms)."""
        d = self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, REG_TEMP, 2)
        return _to_c((d[0] << 8) | d[1])

    def shutdown(self, off=True):
        """Shutdown mode draws <= 3.5 uA; leaving it starts a new conversion."""
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, REG_CONFIG, bytes([_SHUTDOWN if off else 0x00]))

    def one_shot(self):
        """Low-power reading: in shutdown, set ONE-SHOT, wait one conversion, read."""
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, REG_CONFIG, bytes([_SHUTDOWN]))
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, REG_CONFIG, bytes([_ONE_SHOT | _SHUTDOWN]))
        time.sleep_ms(50)
        return self.temperature()

    def set_alarm(self, t_os, t_hyst):
        """OS pin asserts above t_os and releases below t_hyst (comparator mode)."""
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, REG_TOS, _from_c(t_os).to_bytes(2, 'big'))
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, REG_THYST, _from_c(t_hyst).to_bytes(2, 'big'))

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from max30205 import MAX30205

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
sensor = MAX30205(i2c)  # 0x48 with A0-A2 jumpers at their default (GND)
while True:
    print('T=%.2fC' % sensor.temperature())
    time.sleep(1)
